steps.text: Init: the seed starts as two 32-bit words, the low word set to N and the high word to 666.
Draw 1: the seed steps once and the draw is the new low word mod 100, here 87.
calc: new low = its bits 0 to 31 = 22752887; new high = its bits 32 to 63 = 5149.
draw = new low mod n = 22752887 mod 100 = 87.
